QuestInfo.name: The Lost Piece of the VIP Ticket
QuestInfo.0: Where did the ripped piece of the VIP ticket go? I better go see Kevin the Soldier.
QuestInfo.1: The ripped piece of the VIP Ticket has disappeared, so I asked Kevin the Soldier for some help.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, even after losing a ripped piece of VIP ticket, Kevin the Soldier was picking up after me. Phew... thanks a lot.

0.0: 당신을 기다리고 있었어요. 당신이 떠나고 난 뒤에 보니 찢어진 자유여행권을 흘리고 가셨더군요. 여기 어디다가 잘 두었는데 찾아볼게요. 잠시 후에 다시 말을 걸어주세요.
I've been waiting for you here. You left a torn VIP pass on the ground after you left here. I'll check out the place and see if I can find it. Talk to me in a little bit.

1.0: Here you go. I think you left this here.
